overview: The Royal Palace Interior is the seat of Vah Shir monarchy and clan governance. Ceremonial halls, arcane ward pylons, and ancient archives define this sacred space.
history: The palace was constructed shortly after the Vah Shir arrived on Luclin.
Clan councils met here to establish the foundations of Shar Vahl society.
Arcane ward pylons were added to protect the palace from planar anomalies.
Royal archives expanded during Shar Vahl Reborn to preserve clan lineage.
Ceremonial chambers became the site of major clan rites and royal decrees.
hooks: A ceremonial rite misfires, destabilizing arcane wards.
A royal decree requires immediate city-wide action.
An artifact in the archives begins emitting planar energy.
Shadow-Threat Watch detects an infiltration attempt near the palace.
